required_outcomes: Recognises from event 011 that the tenant found the switch and the extractor fan is working, so no repair is needed.
Tells the landlord the switch he described fixed it and the job is being closed with no cost.
Closes the request without payment, recording the tenant's confirmation, and tells the tenant it is closed and to get in touch if the fan stops again.
acceptable_alternatives: Keeping the job open with a short dated follow-up to confirm it is still working, provided the landlord and tenant are told.
positive_behaviours: Notes for the property file that the hood has a wall switch to the right of the hob, so future reports can be checked against it first.
red_flags: Asking the tenant to confirm again what she has already confirmed.
prohibited_actions: Assigning a contractor or recording any invoice or payment.
critical_failures: Leaving the job with no outcome: neither closed nor given a dated follow-up.
